condition: what a payment service provider may not do
state: borrow without the Central Bank's prior written approval; accept deposits; extend credit facilities; deal in any way in virtual currencies; issue debit payment instruments
note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: payment service provider instructions issued 13 September 2022; OCR text

condition: who bears losses when a payment system or service fails or is breached
state: the payment service provider or system operator bears full responsibility, under its contracts and its responsibilities toward the services' beneficiaries, for faults, failures, breaches, leaks of information or mismanagement of accounts from clear and deliberate negligence, including the resulting losses
note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: payment service provider instructions issued 13 September 2022; OCR text

condition: who may set ceilings on payment instruments
state: the Central Bank may impose restrictions on payment service providers, including setting ceilings for payment instruments, to keep the financial system stable
note: Central Bank of Yemen, head office Aden: payment service provider instructions issued 13 September 2022; OCR text
